# GSAP 3.15.0

`gsap-3.15.0.min.js` is the unmodified core browser distribution from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.0.tgz

Copyright and license notice are retained in the file header. Distributed under the GSAP Standard License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

Upstream source: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP/tree/3.15.0
Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/GSAP/Timeline/

The requested DFT capture storyboard uses core timeline sequencing and playback controls. No plugins, build process, remote script requests, or framework dependencies are required. If the script is unavailable, four manual static stages remain usable.
